Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (token volumes & estimate)

Hi Emma 
 great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the action items we discussed: 

Summary of expected workload (your estimates):
- Live chat / customer support flows: ~3M prompt tokens / month (short prompts, avg 60 tokens)
- Follow-up summaries & async tasks: ~12M completion tokens / month (avg 120 tokens)
- Total estimated billable tokens: ~15M tokens / month (prompt + completion)

Budget/target: you mentioned a target spend in the $10k-$15k / month range while benchmarking for full-year coverage. On the call we flagged a target unit economics target of ~$1,000-$1,200 per 1M tokens (effective blended rate across prompt/completion & quantization).

Preliminary ask / next steps:
1) Please confirm the 15M tokens / month rough volume (or provide a low/high band) 
 Emma, a quick reply with a confirmed monthly range would be great.
2) I attached a 1-page invoice estimate + a token cost model we use to show compute/network line items (attachments below).
3) If that aligns, can you loop in procurement (PO timing) and let us know your preferred cadence (monthly vs. quarterly invoice)?

Attachments sent: acme_token_cost_model.xlsx (cost model), rw-invoice-estimate-v1.pdf (sample invoice), token_unit_breakdown.csv (unit price math)

If it helps, I built two scenarios in the sheet 
 baseline (no reserved capacity) and reserved-commit (12-month commit with 20% reserved discount). The baseline blended rate in the model is ~$1,250 per 1M tokens; with a 12-month commit + reserved pools we can get to ~$950-$1,050 / 1M depending on exact shard/throughput needs.

Thanks 
 I can update the sheet for a final PO-ready invoice once you confirm the volume band.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
